prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful editorial Open Graph sharing card for Amit Rathore's personal website. Wide landscape aspect ratio 1200:630 (~1.905:1). A personal essay about consciousness, intelligence, software engineering, writing, and a life of building. Art direction: sophisticated literary journal meets mathematical drawing, quiet and evocative, no corporate stock imagery. Matte very dark forest green #142e2b background with subtle paper grain. Left 52%: beautifully composed, very large warm ivory high-contrast serif typography, exact text "Amit" on first line and "Rathore." on second. Beneath in small refined type the exact line "Consciousness. Intelligence. Possibility." Bottom left small "amitrathore.com". Right 48%: an original exquisite abstract sculpture/drawing of a continuous golden thread, looping between nested elliptical orbits and precise geometric lines, then branching into a few delicate constellation nodes; a small luminous amber sphere is suspended in the quiet center, like a thought taking form. Blend fine copperplate linework, subtle dimensional ribbon-like curves, translucent ivory planes and a small warm rust accent. Mathematical yet human, spacious, intimate, nuanced lighting, timeless museum-poster elegance. The artwork is NOT an eye, not a brain, not a galaxy or sci-fi portal, no AwakeVC logo, no robots, no portrait, no circuit boards. Strong contrast and legible name at social-thumbnail size. All text and the main artwork within generous 65px-equivalent safe margins; no border, no mockup, no watermark. This should feel like a complete designed artwork, not a title pasted over a generic background. Render letters exactly, keep the supporting text simple and unobtrusive.
